input.text: Right now your comparison checks the raw string exactly, character for character. A palindrome test that ignores case and spaces needs a normalized version of the input first — think about transforming the string so that letter case no longer matters and spaces don't get in the way, then compare that cleaned-up form with its reverse.

Normalizing the input before reversing is the key idea.
